area.village.desc: A small village. The people live on farming and logging.
ui.help.text: Pick actions in the columns. Loop actions run until you stop them. Story events appear in the Next Action column and need your choice.
dungeon.bamboo_forest.name: Shadow Bamboo Forest
dungeon.bamboo_forest.desc: A thick bamboo forest behind the village, full of wild beasts. Going in costs time and blood.
reason.story_pending: a story event awaits your choice

technique.dan_khi_nhap_mon.desc: Beginner method: absorb qi and refine cultivation faster, and gain insight for breakthroughs.
mastery.absorb_qi.l20: All qi as one: +40% Spirit Qi
story.ch1.name: Chapter 1: Mortal Hearth Smoke
story.ch1_morning_smoke.title: Morning hearth smoke
story.ch1_morning_smoke.text: Granny Ly stands at her smoky hearth. Her firewood ran out yesterday and the weather is turning cold.
story.ch1_morning_smoke.give_wood.result: Granny Ly beams and promises to remember you.
story.ch1_morning_smoke.sell_wood.result: She pays fair, but looks a little sad.
story.ch1_morning_smoke.ignore.result: You nod and move on. The smoke drifts on.
story.ch1_village_elder.title: The elder's word
story.ch1_village_elder.text: The elder calls you over: "You work hard. Want extra coin hauling water at the pier, or training at the shrine yard?"
story.ch1_village_elder.water_job.result: The pier has a new pair of shoulders.
story.ch1_village_elder.training: Ask to join the shrine-yard drills
story.ch1_village_elder.training.result: He shows a few basics; your Body grows visibly.
story.ch1_forest_edge.title: The forest edge
story.ch1_forest_edge.text: After training you stand at the forest edge. Further in lies a hunters' path lined with medicinal plants.
story.ch1_forest_edge.go_deeper.result: You spot some herbs and pick two sprigs.
story.ch1_forest_edge.edge_wood.result: Dry wood nearby fills the afternoon.
story.ch1_forest_edge.turn_back.result: You head home; the deep forest will wait.
story.ch1_neighbor_gift.title: Granny Ly's gift
story.ch1_neighbor_gift.text: Granny Ly brings a small bundle: some saved silver and a few herbs from her garden.
story.ch1_neighbor_gift.accept.result: She smiles and tells you to keep well.
story.ch1_neighbor_gift.refuse.result: She sighs, "This boy..." but her eyes shine.
ui.auto.locked: Unlocks at Chop wood mastery level 3.
ui.auto.reason.manual_override: You started an action yourself, so the queue stopped.
ui.auto.reason.instant_loop: Stopped: too many instant actions in a row.
ui.auto.reason.offline_not_allowed: Stopped while away: action is not allowed offline.
ui.auto.reason.waiting: Waiting for a resource no slot can produce.
ui.auto.reason.blocked: A slot is blocked and set to Stop.
ui.auto.warn.deadlock_risk: Deadlock risk: a Wait slot lacks a resource no slot produces.
ui.cult.chain: Body training → Sense qi → Absorb → Refine cultivation → Breakthrough
ui.cult.need_method: You need a qi-guiding method (see Story).
knowledge.village_life.desc: Knows the village, its people, and how to earn a meal by honest labour.
knowledge.literacy.desc: Can read price boards, ledgers and simple lines of writing.
knowledge.herb_basics.desc: Can tell which plants heal and which are poison.
knowledge.breathing.desc: Steady breathing to recover strength after heavy work.
knowledge.body_lore.desc: Knows the body has limits, and that training with method can push them.
knowledge.martial_basics.desc: Fundamental stances; the body begins to become a foundation for body tempering.
knowledge.meridian_lore.desc: Knows the body holds channels of blood and vital energy, and why they can be injured.
knowledge.heard_of_cultivators.desc: Has heard that some people in the world can fly across the sky.
knowledge.qi_awareness.desc: Can sense the faint energy flowing between heaven and earth.
knowledge.spirit_root_lore.desc: Knows that each person's innate talent for absorbing spiritual qi differs.
knowledge.dao_entry.desc: Knows what cultivation is and how one first enters the Way. Not yet a method.
reason.not_discovered: you do not know how to do this yet
story.ch2_mountain_rumor.title: Strange Tales from the Mountain
story.ch2_mountain_rumor.text: The hunters come down from the mountain with a tale: strange footprints pressed deep into the rock, and last night someone "rode the wind" across the peak. The whole riverside is buzzing.
story.ch2_mountain_rumor.ask_elder: Press the village elder for the truth
story.ch2_mountain_rumor.ask_elder.resul: The elder sighs: "They are called cultivators. They outlive ordinary folk, but such matters are not for mountain villagers."
story.ch2_mountain_rumor.listen_hunters: Offer the hunters some firewood and hear it all
You listen to every detail, and learn to recognise beast tracks so you can avoid them in the forest.
story.ch2_mountain_rumor.shrug_off: Laugh it off and go back to work
story.ch2_mountain_rumor.shrug_off.resul: The tale lodges in your head all the same, though you hardly believe it.
story.ch3_crossroads.title: A Step into the Martial World
story.ch3_crossroads.text: You are stronger than before. You know you cannot chop wood forever: to go further you must learn something more. Three paths lie ahead.
story.ch3_crossroads.study: Ask the schoolmaster to teach letters and read the old martial book (costs 5 silver)
story.ch3_crossroads.study.result: The schoolmaster takes the silver and shows you a book with worn corners.
story.ch3_crossroads.help: Help the old woodcutter haul timber before the season ends
story.ch3_crossroads.help.result: The old woodcutter glances at you and gives a single nod.
story.ch3_crossroads.explore: Follow the footpath to the mountain's edge and seek your own chance
story.ch3_crossroads.explore.result: Axe on shoulder, you step into the deep shade of the trees.
story.ch3_study.title: The Old Martial Book
story.ch3_study.text: The book records fist stances and how to breathe when exerting strength. The characters are hard, but the schoolmaster explains patiently.
story.ch3_study.careful: Read every page carefully and copy the postures
story.ch3_study.careful.result: You understand why the body aches and why breathing in rhythm makes you last longer. You formally step onto the path of body tempering.
story.ch3_study.skim: Skim it and sell the spare copy
story.ch3_study.skim.result: You remember a few main stances and sell the spare copy for a little silver.
story.ch3_help.title: The Old Woodcutter
story.ch3_help.text: After two days hauling timber, the old woodcutter shows you how to brace your body to lift a load, and how to breathe so you don't run out of wind. "I learned this from a martial master passing through, and I pass it on to those who know hardship."
story.ch3_help.learn_all: Learn from him until it is second nature
story.ch3_help.learn_all.result: You learn breath regulation, how to tell a few medicinal plants apart, and some basic stances. You step onto the path of body tempering.
story.ch3_help.take_pay: Take the wages and pick up a few stances in passing
story.ch3_help.take_pay.result: You take a little silver and remember a few basic stances.
story.ch3_explore.title: The Stranger at the Mountain's Edge
story.ch3_explore.text: An old man in plain cloth is practising fist forms beneath a pine. He looks at you, says nothing, and simply points to the empty spot beside him.
story.ch3_explore.follow: Step up and imitate every movement
story.ch3_explore.follow.result: He says not a word, yet after that session your muscles feel clearer. You step onto the path of body tempering.
story.ch3_explore.watch_hidden: Hide behind a bush, watch, then leave
story.ch3_explore.watch_hidden.result: You remember a few main stances, but dare not approach.
story.ch2.name: Chapter 2: Strange Tales from the Mountain
story.ch3.name: Chapter 3: A Step into the Martial World
knowledge.mem_taoist_wound.desc: You once saw the wounded taoist slumped under the tree at the mountain foot, on that very afternoon.
knowledge.mem_cave_site: Memory: the cave behind the waterfall
knowledge.mem_cave_site.desc: You once saw the old hunter lead the pursuer into the cave behind the waterfall.
knowledge.mem_pursuer_sign.desc: You once saw the sigil on the pursuer's robe clearly, and heard the villagers wave off the warning.
knowledge.mem_last_words.desc: You once heard the taoist whisper his last words before he died.
story.ch1_before_mountain.title: The day before the mountain
story.ch1_before_mountain.text: Your body is hard enough now, and the old hunter asks you to check his traps deep in the mountain tomorrow. It is your first trip past the forest edge. Tonight you can prepare only once.
story.ch1_before_mountain.pack_food: Pack food for two (5 wood traded for rations)
story.ch1_before_mountain.pack_food.resu: The hunter nods and takes your share of food.
story.ch1_before_mountain.go_empty_hande: Go empty-handed, lighter on your feet
You sleep early with nothing on your mind.
story.ch1_wounded_taoist.title: The wounded taoist
story.ch1_wounded_taoist.text: At midday at the mountain foot, a taoist in torn robes sits under a tree clutching a wound. He pants: "Young brother... could you help me?" The old hunter keeps his distance.
story.ch1_wounded_taoist.heal.result: The bleeding stops. The taoist looks at you gratefully.
story.ch1_wounded_taoist.loot.result: You take 30 silver. The taoist's eyes turn ice-cold.
story.ch1_wounded_taoist.ask_first.resul: He smiles bitterly, manages a few words, then coughs blood.
story.ch1_mountain_incident.title: Blood on the mountain
story.ch1_mountain_incident.text: A branch cracks and a cold wind rushes in. A man in black drops from the slope, eyes red as coals: the one hunting the taoist. You realise you are nothing before him. Everything goes dark, and before feeling leaves you, you see one thing clearly.
story.ch1_mountain_incident.stay_by_taoi: He whispers a few last words. You etch each one into memory, then all goes out. You jolt awake on the eve of the mountain trip.
story.ch1_mountain_incident.watch_hunter: Hide behind a rock and watch the hunter
You see him lead the man in black into the cave behind the waterfall, then a scream. You jolt awake on the eve of the mountain trip.
story.ch1_mountain_incident.run_to_villa: Run back to warn the village
You see the sigil on his robe and hear the elder wave you off: "Have you lost your mind?" Then the cold blade. You jolt awake on the eve of the mountain trip.
story.ch1_return.title: The afternoon before
story.ch1_return.text: You sit on the doorstep, whole again. Birdsong, hearth smoke, everything as the day before — but you remember how tomorrow goes. You can change how you face it, and only what you have actually witnessed gives you an edge.
story.ch1_return.rescue: Save the taoist with what you know
story.ch1_return.rescue.result: You decide to reach the mountain foot before the hunter does.
story.ch1_return.trace_hunter: Follow the hunter to the cave
story.ch1_return.trace_hunter.result: You remember his route, and the scream in the cave.
story.ch1_return.warn_village: Warn the villagers about the sigil
story.ch1_return.warn_village.result: You remember the sigil clearly, and also the elder's eyes.
story.ch1_return.keep_secret: Keep the secret and go ahead alone
story.ch1_return.keep_secret.result: You tell no one, not even the hunter.
story.ch4_r_rescue.title: One step ahead
story.ch4_r_rescue.text: You arrive early, before the man in black can see the taoist. He stares at you, shaking, wondering why a village boy has come to save him.
story.ch4_r_rescue.heal_fully: Dress the wound carefully with 3 herbs
story.ch4_r_rescue.heal_fully.result: He nods deeply, accepting the favour.
story.ch4_r_rescue.bind_wound.result: His pain eases, though he is still uneasy.
story.ch4_r_rescue.repeat_last_words: Repeat the words he once whispered
story.ch4_r_rescue.repeat_last_words.res: He pales: "How could you know?" Then looks at you very differently.
story.ch4_r_rescue.ask_first.result: He answers curtly, wary of a strange boy.
story.ch1_taoist_tale.title: The taoist's tale
story.ch1_taoist_tale.text: The taoist speaks of the qi between heaven and earth, and the path cultivators walk. He hands over no method — he only points out the door. To walk through it, you must find your own way.
story.ch1_taoist_tale.listen_closely.res: He sees your sincerity and tells you more of meridians and bones.
story.ch1_taoist_tale.hurry_off.result: You catch only the gist: cultivation is real, and some can guide you.
story.ch4_r_hunter.title: On the hunter's heels
story.ch4_r_hunter.text: The old hunter is startled to find you already waiting at the forest edge. Nobody saves the taoist out there, but you know where the hunter goes — and that something in the cave makes him gamble.
story.ch4_r_hunter.help_hunter.result: He grins: "This boy is useful." He agrees to tell you about the cave.
story.ch4_r_hunter.follow_quietly.result: He spots you tailing him, glares but does not drive you off.
story.ch4_cave_relic.title: The cave behind the waterfall
story.ch4_cave_relic.text: Behind the curtain of water, the rock bears faded script and a torn hide scroll: a Fragmentary Sutra of the ancients. The words are worn, but enough to show a way to guide qi — if you copy them with care.
story.ch4_cave_relic.copy_by_hand: Copy every stroke and leave the scroll in place
story.ch4_cave_relic.copy_by_hand.result: The hunter waits outside and nods, pleased that you were not greedy.
story.ch4_cave_relic.take_scroll.result: Hauling it over the falls toughens you, but the hunter looks at you coldly.
story.ch4_r_warn.title: The warning
story.ch4_r_warn.text: You run through the village telling of the sigil and the man in black. Some laugh, some frown. The elder calls you over, face thunderous: "Who filled your head with nonsense?"
story.ch4_r_warn.warn_elder.result: He thinks you are making it up. The whole village starts to whisper.
story.ch4_r_warn.warn_ba_ly: Ask Granny Ly to vouch, offering 3 wood
story.ch4_r_warn.warn_ba_ly.result: She takes the wood and promises to vouch, but the elder still doubts.
story.ch4_r_proof.title: Finding proof
story.ch4_r_proof.text: To make the villagers believe, you need something to hold. You remember where the man in black stood; he may have left traces.
story.ch4_r_proof.show_sigil: Draw the sigil on bark for the elder (2 wood)
story.ch4_r_proof.show_sigil.result: The elder pales: he has seen this sigil in a book left by a visiting cultivator years ago.
story.ch4_r_proof.search_alone.result: You find a torn scrap embroidered with the sigil. The elder nods only grudgingly.
story.ch4_r_rogue.title: Alone up the mountain
story.ch4_r_rogue.text: You slip up the mountain before the old hunter. The taoist still lies under the tree, and his pouch is heavy with something. Nobody sees you here.
story.ch4_r_rogue.rob_pouch: Take the silver pouch and go
story.ch4_r_rogue.rob_pouch.result: Inside: 30 silver and a hand-drawn map fragment pointing at the waterfall. The taoist glares at you, helpless.
story.ch4_r_rogue.slip_away: Slip away and leave fate to decide
story.ch4_r_rogue.slip_away.result: At the riverside market you hear rumours of wandering cultivators, called rogue cultivators by some.
story.ch1_cave_rumor.title: The map in the pouch
story.ch1_cave_rumor.text: The map in the taoist's pouch sketches a waterfall and a cave behind it, beside scrawled words: "the ancients once sat in meditation". You wonder whether it is worth the risk to go.
story.ch1_cave_rumor.explore.result: You climb the falls, toughening your body. The cave holds only old carvings.
story.ch1_cave_rumor.skip.result: You pocket the map and return to daily work, quieter than before.
story.ch1_qi_clue.title: Traces of qi
story.ch1_qi_clue.text: One still night you notice a strange warmth in your breath. You understand you can sense the "qi" people whisper about.
story.ch1_qi_clue.realize.result: You work out for yourself how to sense qi.
story.ch4_method_guided.title: The taoist's words return
story.ch4_method_guided.text: At the threshold of Qi Sensing you recall what the taoist once said of qi and piece it into a method for guiding qi.
story.ch4_method_guided.recall_words: Piece his words into a method yourself
story.ch4_method_guided.offer_herb: Use 2 herbs to calm the mind and sit in stillness over his guidance
story.ch4_method_guided.offer_herb.resul: Your mind settles and you see your own roots more clearly.
story.ch4_method_relic.title: The sutra on paper
story.ch4_method_relic.text: The Fragmentary Sutra you brought home slowly yields its meaning; stroke by stroke it joins itself.
story.ch4_method_relic.read_clean.result: Only half remains, but enough to begin.
story.ch4_method_relic.decipher_all: Grind 2 herbs into ink and retrace the faded strokes
story.ch4_method_relic.decipher_all.resu: You grasp the full meaning of the sutra.
story.ch4_method_evidence.title: The cultivator's book
story.ch4_method_evidence.text: The elder has met you again since. He remembers a book a cultivator left in his chest, and weighs whether to hand it over.
story.ch4_method_evidence.read_alone: Read what you can of the borrowed cover pages
story.ch4_method_evidence.ask_elder_book: Ask the elder to hand over the whole book
He hands over the book with a few words of warning.
story.ch4_method_rogue.title: A rogue cultivator at the market
story.ch4_method_rogue.text: At the market a rogue cultivator in faded clothes studies you, then asks if you would like to hear how qi is guided. He is neither good nor evil.
story.ch4_method_rogue.steal_glimpse.res: You gather the method in scraps.
story.ch4_method_rogue.trade_with_tan_tu: He takes the silver and recites the whole formula.
story.ch4.name: Chapter 4: Rebirth
story.ch5_path_guided.title: Thanh Huyen's outer gate
story.ch5_path_guided.text: A disciple of Thanh Huyen Sect comes looking for the one who saved their senior. They open the outer gate, on condition you keep your word.
story.ch5_path_guided.prepare.result: You accept and set a day to go up the mountain.
story.ch5_path_evidence.title: The inquiry envoy
story.ch5_path_evidence.text: The villagers believed you after the sigil affair. Thanh Huyen Sect sends someone to investigate and asks if you will serve as a guide.
story.ch5_path_evidence.prepare.result: You agree to guide them in exchange for a recommendation.
story.ch5_path_relic.title: The sutra speaks
story.ch5_path_relic.text: The Fragmentary Sutra hints at a next layer deep in the cave. You must return alone, with no one to guide you.
story.ch5_path_relic.prepare.result: You make ready for the deeper trip.
story.ch5_path_rogue.title: The rogue's road
story.ch5_path_rogue.text: The rogue cultivator invites you to a loose band hunting resources together. No sect protects you, but nothing binds you either.
story.ch5_path_rogue.prepare.result: You agree, knowing it is a gamble.
story.ch5.name: Chapter 5: Threshold of Foundation
ui.auto.error.too_many_slots: Too many slots for your current limit.
ui.auto.error.not_discovered: A chosen action is not yet known to you.
ui.path.title: Immortal Path
ui.path.empty: The road is still dim. Keep living; fate will come.
path.qi_method.name: Find a qi-guiding method
path.qi_method.goal: To sense qi: find someone to guide you, or study the traces in the stone cave.
path.qi_method.blocked: You hold no method yet, only rumours of cultivators.
path.sense_qi.name: Sense qi
path.sense_qi.goal: Sit in stillness and use the method you know to sense qi for the first time.
path.sense_qi.blocked_realm: Your body lacks the foundation to sense qi; train it more.
path.sense_qi.blocked_herb: You need 3 herbs to aid your meditation.
path.first_technique.name: Learn an entry technique
path.first_technique.goal: Learn a technique so qi has a path to flow.
path.first_technique.blocked_realm: Reach Qi Refining 1 before you can learn a technique.
path.first_technique.blocked_herb: You need 2 herbs to learn the technique.
path.bamboo_forest.name: Test yourself in the Shadow Bamboo Forest
path.bamboo_forest.goal: You have some martial skill now; try the Shadow Bamboo Forest.
path.foundation.name: Toward Foundation Establishment
path.foundation.goal: Gather cultivation up to Qi Refining 9, then prepare the Foundation ritual.
path.foundation.blocked_realm: You have not reached Qi Refining 9.
story.ch1_wounded_taoist.heal.later: The man you saved may remember the kindness and point the way later.
story.ch1_wounded_taoist.loot.later: The silver helps now, but you must find a method yourself through the cave traces.
story.ch1_wounded_taoist.ask_first.later: You learn more of the story, but the taoist has little strength left to teach you.
story.ch1_mountain_incident.text.healed: A branch cracks and a cold wind rushes in. A man in black drops from the slope, eyes red as coals: the hunter of the taoist you just bandaged. You realise you are nothing before him. Everything goes dark, and before feeling leaves you, you see one thing clearly.
story.ch1_mountain_incident.text.robbed: A branch cracks and a cold wind rushes in. A man in black drops from the slope, eyes red as coals: the hunter of the taoist whose pouch you just took. The heavy pouch at your waist suddenly feels ice-cold. Everything goes dark, and before feeling leaves you, you see one thing clearly.
ui.cult.no_main: No main technique chosen: only the intro technique applies.
ui.cult.wounds: Wounds: %d/%d (cut HP in dungeons; rest to heal)
reason.not_main_technique: This technique cannot be a main technique.
reason.not_known: You have not learned this technique.
technique.thanh_moc_duong_khi.desc: Safe and steady: faster absorption, more health, quicker recovery. No damage bonus.
technique.huyet_luyen_than_kinh.desc: Risky: more damage and faster body training, but every dungeon run leaves a wound.
technique.ngu_hanh_dan_khi.desc: Slow start and needs cave clues to learn; in return a much better chance of insight at breakthroughs.
action.brew_pill: Brew Qi Recovery Pill (-2 Herb, +1 Pill)
dungeon.black_rock_cave.name: Black Rock Cave
dungeon.black_rock_cave.desc: A deep black cave behind the waterfall. The deeper you go, the fiercer the beasts and the richer the spoils, but every tier eats your time.
knowledge.mem_black_rock: Memory: the bottom of the Black Rock Cave
knowledge.mem_black_rock.desc: You saw the Rock Guardian fall with your own eyes, and begin to guess why someone hunted this place.
path.black_rock.name: Reach the bottom of the Black Rock Cave
path.black_rock.goal: The black cave behind the waterfall hides more; brew pills and go down one tier at a time.
path.black_rock.blocked_realm: Reach Qi Refining 3 before the Black Rock Cave is within your strength.
reason.not_paused: not a moment for that choice
ui.dungeon.tiers: %d tiers; each adds %s years of age
ui.dungeon.paused: Tier %d cleared. Go deeper or stop here?
ui.dungeon.hint.wounded: Last time you lost while wounded; rest and heal before going back in.
ui.dungeon.hint.out_of_pills: Last time you lost with no pills; brew more Qi Recovery Pills and bring them.
ui.dungeon.hint.too_strong: Last time you lost even with pills; leave earlier or change your main technique.
